description: Latest or a single day's exchange rates. The raw-rate companion to `convert`. With `provider`, published rates from one or more institutions: on its own base the digits are as published, with the date they took effect.

date.description: Single day YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the latest rates.

provider.description: Provider key or keys, e.g. ECB or ['ECB', 'HMRC']. Serves published rates instead of the blend; a date inside a weekly, monthly or quarterly provider's period returns the rate in force. Keys at https://frankfurter.dev/providers/.

providers.description: Alias for `provider` accepting multiple provider keys.

quotes.description: ISO 4217 quote codes to return; omit for all.

name: get_rates
title: Get exchange rates
